source: Good Sam directory (PUBLIC_PARK and local-named rows with no entry within 2 km) and every named OSM tourism=camp_site/caravan_site with no entry within 1.5 km, read by name
note: Nine added: Jetty Park (Canaveral Port Authority, 177 sites) and eight Northwest Florida Water Management District recreation areas whose reservable sites take RVs (Florida River Island, Christoff Landing, Dead River Landing, Tom Johns Landing, White Oak Landing, Mystic Springs, Williams Lake, Blue Spring) - filed local like the DB's existing Cotton Lake (NWFWMD) and Istokpoga Canal (SFWMD). Excluded: NWFWMD group, equestrian and tent/van-only sites; Seminole County's tent-scale Lake Mills Park. Follow-up: the other water management districts' campsites are not rostered yet, and ~250 private campgrounds are unmatched in OSM.

excluded.name: NWFWMD Rattlesnake Lake N/S, Lost Lake, Pine Ridge, Spurling, Devil's Hole, Longleaf, Seashell, Otto Hill
excluded.why: single group sites (Rattlesnake, Lost Lake), equestrian (Pine Ridge), or tent/van/pickup only (Spurling, Devil's Hole, Longleaf, Seashell, Otto Hill)

excluded.name: Lake Mills Park (Seminole County)
excluded.why: 14-site tent-oriented campground; parking pads sized for cars, not RVs
